title: AI at Moscow conference judged Apollo photos synthetic
summary: Joe Rogan tells of AI at Moscow conference judged Apollo photos synthetic, about c. 2023 at Moscow, Russia, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: where Putin was at this conference, this the AI conference of two years ago in Moscow.

plain: A podcast host, Joe Rogan, passes on what a man named Bart Sibrel told him: that at an artificial intelligence conference in Moscow about two years earlier, attended by Russia's president Vladimir Putin, an AI judged photographs from Apollo, the American moon landings, to be fake. If true, it would cast doubt on the famous moon photos.
